candidates.title: Spatial LLM Workload Shifting Needs Foresight: Model Commitment for AI Data Center Operation under Power Grid Constraints
candidates.reason: Adjacent infrastructure scheduling work jointly modeling model-replica loading and cross-site request routing under power/grid constraints, with prefill/decode latency translated into serving capacity. Reports 100% service rate under time-varying grid conditions and 29.0% lower operating cost; useful for deployment/scheduling lineage.
